crossRefs.note: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when…
He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;
Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so it was well, then. Wasn’t this to know me?” says Yahweh.

translations.web: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
translations.bsb: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
translations.kjv: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
translations.asv: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.
